description: Use when the user wants to buy one or more products. This store's availability is not confirmed here, so no checkout link is created: the tool returns the product page on the store's own site for each item. Pass variant IDs (items) and/or product URLs (product_urls). Use search_products first.

decision_id.description: Optional — leave unset unless an earlier create_checkout error asked for it.

items.description: Products to add to cart by variant ID

selling_plan_id.description: Shopify selling plan ID for subscriptions

variant_id.description: Shopify variant ID (numeric or GID format)

note.description: Cart note visible to the merchant

product_urls.description: Products to add to cart by URL — resolved to variant IDs automatically

name: create_checkout
